column3: Fayette County Schools NTI Day on Thursday 2/20:
column4: NTI Day due to cold temperatures and additional snow accumulation forecasted.
In effect from Feb. 19 at 7 p.m. until Feb. 20 at 7 a.m.
Use added caution, slow down, and increase following distances.  Possible black ice due to subfreezing temperatures, especially on bridges and overpasses.
